name: Logitech MX Master 3S (Bluetooth)
notes: 97-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech MX Master 3S, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/a349659846ef20078ef1c831f53ed282/libinput-record-bluetooth. Bluetooth, so the descriptor is the device's whole HID report map. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
